Concurrent Resolution of the Senate and Assembly proposing an amendment to

Debar Pond Institute in order to facilitate the preservation of historic
buildings
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7868

SPONSOR: STEC
 
TITLE OF BILL:

CONCURRENT RESOLUTION OF THE SENATE AND ASSEMBLY proposing an amendment
to section 1 of article 14 of the Constitution, in relation to conveying
land to Debar Pond Institute in order to facilitate the preservation of
historic buildings

 
PURPOSE:

Amends the constitution to convey land to Debar Pond Institute in order
to facilitate the preservation of historic buildings.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Proposing an amendment to section 1 of article 14 of the Constitution,
in relation to conveying land to Debar Pond Institute in order to facil-
itate the preservation of historic buildings.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Debar Lodge was built in 1940s as a private residence and was
designed by architect William Distin, who is most famous for designing
the Whiteface Inn and the 1932 Olympic Arena in Lake Placid The State
took ownership of the Debar Lodge in 2004, and the buildings have not
been utilized since then. The Adirondack Park Agency and Department of
Environmental Conservation proposed tearing down the lodge and replacing
it with a Debar Lodge Day Use Area.

To preserve this historic landmark that is part of the National Register
of Historic Places, the Debar Pond Institute will exchange 400 acres of
land adjacent to Debar Pond for the 6 acres that include the Debar Pond
Lodge through a constitutional amendment due to article 14 of the state
constitution. This amendment to article 14 of the state constitution
will convey the land to the Debar. Lodge Institute, who will own and
manage the lodge and property with plans to provide public programming
and educational opportunities there.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
The foregoing amendment be referred to the first regular legislative
session convening after the next succeeding general election of members
of the assembly
